alasan: Grasping the meaning of something matches 'know and comprehend the nature or meaning of'.
'Search or examine' fits sense 4 (search); reader still understands narrator looked into the privy.
'At the present time' matches sense 4 'at the present moment'; same reading as 'in these times'.
'To the greatest extent' is the superlative sense 1; 'most likely' is understood the same way.
Belief that something is true matches 'expect, believe, or suppose'.
Ceasing an action or activity matches 'put an end to a state or an activity'.
Rubbing with the nose fits sense 2 (rub noses); affectionate snuggling reading of sentence unchanged.
Dressing the child means placing a garment on her, a specialised use of sense 1.
Speaking sharply or angrily matches 'utter in an angry, sharp, or abrupt tone'.
Sudden moment of insight matches 'a sudden brilliant understanding'.
Not trying to appear more important than it is matches 'lacking pretension or affectation'.
Developing abilities earlier than usual matches exceptionally early development or maturity.
Bored and unenthusiastic from having too much matches 'dulled by surfeit'.
Recurring theme in musical work (Indonesian gloss specifies music) matches the musical motif sense.
Word by which a person is known matches sense 1.
Perceiving with the eyes matches 'perceive by sight'.
Taking something away from a position matches removing something concrete by lifting or taking off.
Ceasing to happen matches the activity ending, i.e. 'put an end to a state or activity'.
The action of repeating matches 'the act of doing or performing again'.
'Person or company that makes goods' includes the person sense; sentence refers to a named individual.
Allowing something despite disliking it captures 'put up with something unpleasant'.
Coming after someone in place, walking behind, matches 'travel behind, go after'.
Gloss is shame as a painful emotion (sense 1), not the gold 'state of dishonor'.
Coming into one's mind matches 'come to one's mind; suggest itself'.
Greater amount or degree matches the comparative quantifier used with mass noun 'time'.
Gloss is 'mode in which something is manifested' (sense 11), not the gold human-body sense.
'Belonging to the very distant past' is sense 1; reader still understands a very old justice.
Grass-covered land suitable for grazing matches sense 1.
Allowing something to happen matches 'make it possible ... for something to happen'.
A number of different types matches 'a collection containing a variety of sorts of things'.
Written messages sent to a newspaper match 'written message addressed to a person or organization'.
'In one's own opinion' matches 'concerning the speaker'.
Containing specific words matches 'have or contain a certain wording or form'.
'Completely or entirely' matches 'to the greatest extent; completely'.
Looking at the wingman over time as he moves matches 'follow with the eyes'.
At a lower position matches 'in or to a place that is lower'.
A single instance, only one moment with no others, matches 'without any others being included'.
Small box as a confined, limited space reflects 'limited or below average in extent'.
